deliverables.change: New Messages API runner (fetch, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, optional base url): cache_control on system and prefix blocks; maps usage and cost to the runner result shape {text,sessionId:null,usage,costUsd,durationMs,turns:1,model,baselineTokens,tools,endTokens,toolUses}; timeout; typed error classes. Header comment states why this differs from #5347 and #2385 (single runner seam, diff already embedded and bounded, CLI fallback, default off, builder stays on CLI).

makeLeanRunner takes apiRoles, apiFallback and an apiRunner; a role in apiRoles with a key and an apiEligible call routes to the API; otherwise falls back to the CLI when fallback=cli, or throws when fallback=fail. Result carries route api|cli. Default options leave behaviour unchanged.

Pass apiRoles/apiFallback through; reviewer and verifier call sites set apiEligible only when the diff is within REVIEW_DIFF_MAX_BYTES and no relaxations need file reads; grouper eligible; record route (api|cli) on the attempt record.
Reviewer and verifier prompts expose a stable shared prefix (rubric, contract, diff) plus a variable tail; the concatenated text the CLI path sees is byte-identical to today.

Read forge.yaml lean.api_roles (list, default empty) and lean.api_fallback (cli|fail, default cli) via readLeanSetting next to reviewerModel/fixModel and pass them in the options at both option-assembly sites (~1094 and ~1954).
New report: from the ledger, fresh CLI sessions per merged issue, cache-write share and cost per merged issue, split by route, with a before/after comparison by cutoff timestamp.
New replay tool: runs a stored reviewer prompt through the CLI and API runners and compares blocking findings; exits clearly when no API key is set.
Tests with a fake fetch: request shape (cache_control), usage-to-cost mapping, runner result contract, timeout/error classes, report and parity helpers.
Routing tests: configured role with key goes to API; missing key, ineligible call or API error falls back under cli and throws under fail; default config unchanged.
Reviewer and verifier lane tests parse findings from API-style text; oversize diff and relaxations stay on the CLI; route recorded.
Document lean.api_roles, lean.api_fallback, the API route and its limits, the report and parity tools, and why this differs from #5347/#2385.
